headers.//: Everything is no-cache by default. The entry document must never be cached: it names the hashed asset files, so a stale copy pins the app to an old build. The WebView inside Town Pass honours this and nothing else would make it let go — the previous rule used source '/index.html', which never matched a request for '/', so the page was being cached for an hour and deploys did not reach the phone.
Asset filenames contain a content hash, so a given URL can never change. Later rules win, so this overrides the blanket no-cache above.
